description: Reference IF-Merge results on the CLIP benchmark with the default recipe (configs/if_merge/clip.yaml; 256 + 256 unlabeled calibration images per task). Accuracies are task-averaged test accuracies in percent. holdout_kl lists the holdout KL at the initialization (round 0) and after every round; the endpoint is the round with the lowest holdout KL. mean and sd (sample standard deviation) summarize the endpoint accuracy over calibration seeds 0-2. Some entries list only the endpoint accuracy, rounded to two decimals.
